color-no-hex.message: Use a colour token: var(--bg-canvas), var(--fg-default) and so on.

color-named.message: Use a colour token, not a named colour.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use a colour token. Raw colour functions belong in tokens/ only.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use rem (px / 16) or a token. px is only for 1px and 2px hairlines and optical nudges.
